description: This file provides Korean language translations for the Select2 plugin version 4.0.6-rc.1, defining localized strings for error messages, input constraints, loading statuses, maximum selections, no results, and searching indicators.

methods.name: errorLoading
methods.description: Returns the message displayed when results cannot be loaded.

methods.name: inputTooLong
methods.description: Returns message indicating input is too long and specifies the number of characters to delete.

methods.name: inputTooShort
methods.description: Returns message indicating input is too short and specifies the number of additional characters needed.

methods.name: loadingMore
methods.description: Returns message displayed when more results are being loaded.

methods.name: maximumSelected
methods.description: Returns message indicating the maximum number of selections allowed.

methods.name: noResults
methods.description: Returns message indicating no search results were found.

methods.name: searching
methods.description: Returns message indicating a search is in progress.
